meta.notes: the verb set (the tavern/road action contract — the base sixteen plus the province's own: council, hold_vigil, patrol, since iter-161 the flood-story read read_pole and since iter-167 the step-law read read_stair; the engine's closed grammar, every verb pack data; the province nouns live in the knowledge tokens and the hook ids below). The move action keeps the edge-priced travel (st-6a/D-116 (5) — the province runs the TRAVEL main loop, D-146's opening answer: the loop change is the universal-core test)

actions.label: look around
actions.notes: cheap perception of the current location: who/what is present (scene detail deepens with the perception system, iter-3)

actions.label: examine
actions.notes: targeted inspection of one entity or spot present in the actor's location

actions.label: study
actions.notes: the flood-story recognition read (the pole's embodiment seed, iter-161 — the social-recognition half of WORLD_WORKPLAN §6's candidate 2, the owner's call): the pole is the flood story made physical — the high-water stain, the repair splice, the season tallies on the haft (each fat season's payment notched, a debt's count kept in wood by a family that signs with a blade, not a pen). The close read mints the literal token the_flood_story — the secrets registry's key (the templated-token ineligibility law: a secret's subject is fixed, the literal vocabulary the only legal surface — the grim read_ticket precedent's second instance, the pawn-ticket hinge's shape). The reader who learns the flood story holds the lever at the stair (ANCHOR_REGION §6.1's NEW OPTION rung): the debt named aloud where the road can hear. The field_in read pins the target to the pole (studying any other stave mints nothing). The perception gate is the honest failure surface: a failed read mints only the vague unread marks — wear seen, meaning missed; the acquisition conditions ride the saw channel besides (the unlit stair at night steps the story down to partial — half the tale legible by dark).

actions.label: study
actions.notes: the step bench's setting verb (stepread, iter-167 — the step's close read, the unit's first embodiment, the owner's continuation call over the embodiment options: WORLD_WORKPLAN §6 candidate 3; the read hinge's third instance — the grim read_ticket first, the pole second): the stair IS the law's own text — the water law lives in stone (the feud's material lesson: the timber law died in the mill's fire), four rungs, the head each names, one shared by three hands (the step law, ANCHOR_REGION §6.2). The close read mints the literal token the_step_law — the ORDER the road never learns from the books (§6.2's knowledge asymmetry: the stranger reads a stingy ferryman, never the order — the books show the toll, not the step; §7.1's stranger row — the road's misread correctable in play, the meaning slice's committed-band widening). The token is deliberately NOT a secret: the step law is the vale's own category (the humor probe's shared-categories proof — the step a category the whole vale owns), public custom held by the practitioners' reading, no lever over any subject — plain knowledge, the brief's recalled facts the read surface (the pole's debt-lever class NOT duplicated: no secrets entry, no cluster, the registry stays two keys). The location-kind target is the hinge family's first non-item read (the stair is the carrier itself, not a thing at the stair — the field_in read pins the target to the weirstair; studying any other stone mints nothing). The perception gate is the honest failure surface: a failed read mints only the vague unread steps — steps seen, order missed. The acquisition conditions ride the saw channel (the unlit weir after dark steps the order down to partial — half the rungs legible by dark). Honest boundary (the substrate gaps stay owner-routed, the separate-track law): the read mints the LAW, never the PRESENT — the phases carry no head (the water level), so the wet step's current standing is authored, not runtime; the stone says what the rungs mean, not what the river does today.

actions.label: travel to
actions.notes: the travel twin (st-6a, D-116 (5)): movement along the location graph priced by the exits edge — the derived travel price at the accept door (resolve time, L3: derive, never store), the completion enqueued at t + price (beats, rotations and macro crossings still fire mid-travel in tick order, D-038); carried items move with the carrier; the arrival snapshot learns one exact presence token per entity at the destination (st-1). The province's legs are hours-to-a-day (rules.json travel) — the artery's own scale

actions.label: talk
actions.notes: social exchange; the trust floor is the relations gate (phase0 §2, Prom Week donor); the seed of rumor transfer — trusted tellers spread faster (iter-3)

actions.label: wait
actions.notes: advance N ticks; the world moves while the player stands still. content-3 (iter-53, D-082): every committed wait seeds the ambient tag — idle time is the noise floor's domain (D-005: the murmur is seeded at event time, never improvised; the tag is weight 0, so the seeding shifts no entropy anywhere)

actions.label: take
actions.notes: picking up an uncarried item present in the location; the stealth check applies only with other entities present (MVP_SCOPE §7 'stealth if owner near'); taking a carried item is steal's job. iter-11: texture-capable (blueprint §1 promotion) — a step carrying the mediator-resolved 'texture' reference takes the texture path: the pack's texture.requires replace the canon ones and a success is the slot's canon birth on the scope target

actions.label: drop / break
actions.notes: noise on break; a dropped fire source at a flammable spot may ignite (rules.json transitions.fire, chance_on_drop_break — the §3 walkthrough's lamp)

actions.label: use
actions.notes: context-dependent effect from the item's pack use_effect (ale → intoxication); observers see the use

actions.label: steal
actions.notes: pickpocket: opposed stealth vs the target's perception; the target must carry a steal_target item (the pay tin on the duty sergeant — the province's theft family — and since iter-161 the punt pole on the second hand, the verb-gate boundary's unless-arm); failure mints the sighting + the noise tokens (the drift family's members, the suspicion ladder's anchors) and seeds the watcher hooks

actions.label: distract
actions.notes: shifts target attention (status.attention → distracted, a perception modifier via rules.checks.skills.perception); the 'method: distraction' modifier on steal is the separate in-attempt gambit

actions.label: set fire
actions.notes: impossible without a usable fire source at a flammable target (T5): the tallow lamp at the tithe barn / the charcoal stacks — the province's arson exposure (the manor's barn the designed target, the crofts' stacks the standing hazard); witnesses mint the sighting pair

actions.label: rest
actions.notes: the fatigue counter-play (tune-1, KI#4: player fatigue was monotonic over long waits — nothing in v0.1 could bring it down). One hour of rest clears 30 fatigue (the 720-tick waits of the canonical day gain 20); resting at fatigue 0 is a legal quiet beat (no state change). The delta lives here beside its action (use_effect precedent); the axis and its gain rate live in rules.json states

actions.label: demand papers
actions.notes: the manifest demand (the document-check family, iter-43's content-1 — the road's toll papers re-voiced as the half-pay levy's waybill check): perception reads the traveler, social answers for him; the verdict mints the suspicion ladder's papers rung (band 50 + 25 >= arrest 75)

actions.label: lean on
actions.notes: the leverage spend (social-1b, iter-45, D-074 — the fact cluster's first runtime consumer): the holder plays the card. The door is the leverage test itself (actor.leverage_over — the intent door's first fold-reading precondition; a holder with no live cluster is rejected, a spent or expired cluster likewise — the fold is the only truth); the spend is a NEW EVENT naming the cluster's id in outcome.cluster (never a mutation — the fold kills the cluster at the spend's tick, INV-1), the loop stamping cluster/secret/type from the live fold at commit. The balance (what the cluster buys): the subject's directed pair axes toward the holder shift — trust breaks fast (−25, D-030's darkness-as-data law) and fear spikes (+25) — the v0.1 buy is the relation shift itself; a status/urgency nudge stays recorded-not-built (the first-consumer law). No check: the leverage IS the power (the reveal happens; a resisting subject is the option layer's future, the drama-2 grammar). No knowledge records: the corner is quiet — the room sees nothing, the reaction cascade terminates exactly as leverage_gained's does (the one-hop law's sibling). The compliance (the subject DOING what the holder wants) is P3e psychological-echo territory — never this action. DORMANT in the committed content set: no urgency/director driver carries it (the iter-38 climax-flag pattern — landing one shifts the RNG stream and re-distills the whole corpus; content-4 owns the live call). The subject must be an npc (kind test — pc_01 is one); the actor is whoever holds a live cluster over them

actions.label: flee
actions.notes: exit under pursuit: opposed evasion vs the best pursuit skill present; no potential pursuer → automatic; guards' chase knowledge deepens with the crime system (iter-3): pursuers at the destination see exactly where the runner went

actions.label: ramble
actions.notes: the 16th action (content-3, iter-53, D-082 — DIR-4's ambient channel gains its live consumer): an idle audible beat — the actor rambles, the room hears (vague, heard). No check (noise is not communication), no state change, no consequence hooks of its own. The observe resolver is the mechanic (an in-location perception event whose knowledge templates are this pack data); the director's ambient hook is the driver, the parse grammar gains a legal idle verb beside wait/look_around.

actions.label: council
actions.notes: the guild's goal verb (the triangle, slice 3): the trade's flinch made public — the stalls bar, the heads come together. A bare story-beat expression (no declared effect of its own; the attribution row is the witness that keeps it alive, PACK_SPEC §5).

actions.label: hold vigil
actions.notes: the families' goal verb (the triangle, slice 3): the old blood's public act — the wergeld vigil, the blood price spoken aloud again. Bare story beat, the D-160 muster pattern at province scale.

actions.label: patrol
actions.notes: the garrison's goal verb (the triangle, slice 3): the half-pay watch walks its frightened round. Bare story beat, the escalation arm's public answer.
